## Examples of code for combining result sets

```r
#| label: example-1

cont <- azkit::get_container(Sys.getenv("AZ_CONTAINER_RESULTS"))
bbcs_org_codes <- c("RBK", "RL4", "RNA", "RRK", "RXK")
filter_string <- paste0("dataset eq '", bbcs_org_codes, "'", collapse = " or ")
select_cols <- paste0(c("scenario", "aggregated_results_path"), collapse = ",")

modelruns <- Sys.getenv("AZ_RUNS_TABLE") |>
  azkit::read_azure_table(filter = filter_string, select = select_cols)

bbcs_scenarios <- paste0("20260723-", bbcs_org_codes, "-BASELINE-DEFAULT-35-36")

# get the Azure paths to the results data
scenario_paths <- modelruns |>
  dplyr::filter(.data[["scenario"]] %in% bbcs_scenarios) |>
  dplyr::pull("aggregated_results_path")

# check we have got the expected number of scenarios
length(scenario_paths) == length(bbcs_org_codes)

# read data from parquets and bind into a single tibble
stepcounts_combined <- scenario_paths |>
  purrr::map(\(x) reskit::read_results_parquet_files(cont, x, "step_counts")) |>
  purrr::map("step_counts") |>
  purrr::list_rbind()

# create a minimal results list
results <- list(step_counts = stepcounts_combined)

# process the data and generate the plot
results |>
  reskit::compile_grouped_impact_data(measure = "admissions") |>
  reskit::make_grouped_impact_plot()
```
